raw_response: {"diagnosis": "All 327 rows with source_tz='UTC' (batch 13) carry UTC timestamps, while the other batches are Chicago local time. Batch 13 starts at 12:00 UTC, which is 06:00 Chicago, the same opening time the other batches show. Its late-evening rows therefore spill past midnight into 2026-01-18 00:00-06:00 (the 72 flagged rows) and are also assigned the wrong txn_date. Converting UTC rows to America/Chicago in silver_transactions fixes this and corrects every downstream gold table.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.86, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH n AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM n;"}}
